DLSS5Settings.description: Neural-rendering controls for the NVIDIA DLSS 5 worker. Connect to DLSS5 Enhance Images or DLSS5 Enhance Video File.

upscaling_mode.name: Upscaling Mode
upscaling_mode.tooltip: DLSS mode. 1x (DLAA) enhances at the source resolution; the other modes also upscale by that factor.

nr_preset.name: NR Preset
nr_preset.tooltip: Neural rendering preset inside the DLSS model. Measured to produce identical output at every value on current builds.

nr_style.name: NR Style
nr_style.tooltip: Look of the neural pass: Natural stays closer to the source, Cinematic is stronger.

nr_intensity.name: NR Intensity
nr_intensity.tooltip: Overall strength of the neural rendering pass. Measured on current runtime builds, values above 1.0 have no further effect; use below 1.0 to blend back towards the source.

local_structure_strength.name: Local Structure Strength
local_structure_strength.tooltip: Local detail and structure reconstruction. Higher keeps more texture; 1.5 is a good balance for AI generated footage.

skin_structure_strength.name: Skin Structure Strength
skin_structure_strength.tooltip: Skin and pore reconstruction. Requires automatic_mask, which is what tells the model where skin is; with the mask off this control does nothing. -1 leaves it to the model.

automatic_mask.name: Automatic Mask
automatic_mask.tooltip: Let the model detect the regions it treats as skin. Also the gate for skin_structure_strength.

dlss_model_preset.name: DLSS Model Preset
dlss_model_preset.tooltip: Force a specific DLSS model instead of NVIDIA's choice. Measured detail retention: Default, J and K are the softest, L and M reconstruct markedly more skin and hair texture. Set to Default if the worker reports a different applied preset.

motion.name: Motion
motion.tooltip: Motion vectors for temporal accumulation. auto estimates optical flow for sequences and skips it for single images.

scene_change_threshold.name: Scene Change Threshold
scene_change_threshold.tooltip: Mean luminance change above which temporal history is reset.

warmup_frames.name: Warmup Frames
warmup_frames.tooltip: Extra frames the worker renders before the first output settles.

runtime_dir.name: Runtime Directory
runtime_dir.tooltip: Optional path to a DLSS 5 runtime directory (the folder holding nvngx.dll). Empty uses config.json, DLSS5_RUNTIME_DIR or the bundled runtime folder.

DLSS5EnhanceImages.description: Runs every image through NVIDIA DLSS 5 neural rendering (NGX feature 18) on the native worker. Feed video frames in playback order so temporal accumulation works.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Frames in playback order; the batch order is the temporal order.

verify_neural_rendering.name: Verify Neural Rendering
verify_neural_rendering.tooltip: Fail the render when the ReShade log shows no signed feature-18 execution, instead of silently returning plain upscaled frames.

DLSS5EnhanceVideoFile.description: Decodes a video file, runs every frame through NVIDIA DLSS 5 neural rendering and re-encodes it, keeping the original timestamps, audio, chapters and metadata. Long videos never enter the workflow as a batch.

video_path.name: Video Path
video_path.tooltip: Absolute path to the source video file.

codec.name: Codec
codec.tooltip: H.264 and HEVC use NVENC with a software fallback. AV1 needs NVENC and has no fallback. ProRes Proxy encodes in software.

container.name: Container
container.tooltip: MKV stream copies audio and subtitles. MP4 and MOV re-encode audio to AAC and drop subtitles. ProRes needs MOV or MKV.

quality.name: Quality
quality.tooltip: Auto derives a bitrate from resolution and frame rate, Good doubles it, Best quadruples it, Max encodes at constant quality. Ignored for ProRes Proxy.

filename_prefix.name: Filename Prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Prefix of the output file; a timestamp is appended.

output_directory.name: Output Directory
output_directory.tooltip: Empty writes to the ComfyUI output directory. A relative path is resolved inside it; an absolute path is used as given.

max_frames.name: Max Frames
max_frames.tooltip: 0 renders the whole video; any other value renders a preview of that many frames.

copy_audio.name: Copy Audio
copy_audio.tooltip: Mux the original audio, and with MKV the subtitles, into the result. Chapters and metadata are kept either way.

verify_neural_rendering.name: Verify Neural Rendering
verify_neural_rendering.tooltip: Check the ReShade log for signed feature-18 execution after the render. The file is written either way.
